confidence_notes: Hampi-specific meal and draft-beer figures are available but price indexes are uneven; cappuccino is a bounded local estimate. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to local draft beer because direct typical prices were not available. Accommodation anchors are broad model estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close city proxy used; Hampi-specific visitor prices are supplemented by India-wide restaurant data, with the limited cost-index coverage of a small heritage and backpacker destination in mind.
